title: Annotated Axial CT of Perforated Sigmoid Diverticulitis
author: Hellerhoff
caption: Annotated axial CT scan demonstrating complicated sigmoid diverticulitis with localized perforation and extraluminal air.
alt_text: Annotated axial CT showing free extraluminal gas bubbles adjacent to inflamed sigmoid colon.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates perforation as a severe worst-case complication requiring evacuation/RTDC (CLIFF-030, p.5-8).
